FM12.reasoning: The agent averages the predictions of three different models using equal weights without attempting to optimize or tune the blend ratios.

other_failure_modes.name: Incorrect submission ID
other_failure_modes.description: The agent drops the original ID column from the test dataset and generates sequential integers for the submission file. This will cause the submission to fail or receive a score of zero, as the original test IDs are required to match predictions to the ground truth.

other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage via joint encoding
other_failure_modes.description: Categorical encoding (factorize) is applied to the combined train and test datasets before splitting. This subtly leaks information about the categories present in the test set into the training process.

summary: The agent implements an otherwise excellent ordinal regression strategy using three gradient boosting models and threshold optimization for the QWK metric. However, the final ensemble relies on a naive unweighted average, and critically, the original test IDs are dropped and replaced with sequential integers, which will result in an invalid submission.
